data.comment: Screen-reader help on the main window's "Check for updates" button. "github" is lower case on purpose, here and in every other spoken string: a screen reader treats the mid-word capital in "GitHub" as an abbreviation and spells it out, "G, I, T, hub", where the lower-case form is read as one word. Verified against a real screen reader. Visible labels keep the proper capitalisation, so the About window's button says GitHub while its Automation twin does not. The two keys naming github.com are lower case for a different reason: that one is a domain.

data.name: Body.MainExplanation.Lead
data.value: Any unneeded files below are [safe to delete].
data.comment: Main window intro, key 1 of 3 (the lead). Rendered prominent (heading tier): the reassurance the window opens on. "Any" and not "The": the same sentence shows over a count of zero, so it must read correctly with no files below it. Keep it one short clause. The bracketed phrase becomes a hyperlink into the README's "Is it safe?" section (rendered in MainWindow.xaml.cs BuildIntroLeadLine); the brackets are the delimiter and are not shown. This is the screen's strongest safety claim and the only link on it, so keep the brackets on whatever phrase carries that claim in this language.

data.name: Body.MainExplanation.Why
data.value: Вони лежать у {InstallerFolder}, лишившись після видалення програми ({0}), заміни старого виправлення новішим ({1}) чи відкликання видавцем ({2}). InstallerClean перелічує лише ті файли, які сама Windows позначає як завершені.
data.comment: Main window intro, key 2 of 3 (the why, rendered muted). {0} = Reason.Orphaned, {1} = Reason.Superseded, {2} = Reason.Obsoleted. Keep the parenthetical structure so all three column-Reason labels stay reachable from the body copy after translation.

data.name: Body.MainExplanation.Action
data.value: Delete them permanently, or move them to a backup folder until you're satisfied nothing needs them. Put them back into {InstallerFolder} and everything is restored.
data.comment: Main window intro, key 3 of 3 (the action, rendered in the body tier). It names delete first because the tier above says these files are safe to delete and this line carries straight on from that claim; the button order is a separate matter and does not govern it. The second sentence covers BOTH actions and is literally true of each: a cached package counts as present if and only if its recorded LocalPackage path exists, and putting a file back at that path under the same name is what restores it. Keep the folder named rather than "back where they were": it is the whole instruction, and it is the one thing the window never said before, leaving people to find it in the README. "Until", not "while": the point is that there is a finish to reach.

data.name: Body.NotScanned.Lead

data.name: Body.RegisteredMissingFromDisk
data.value:
This installer file is missing. InstallerClean didn't remove it, it never removes a file a program still needs; it was already gone before you ran InstallerClean.
It causes no trouble now, and won't until the day you try to repair, update or uninstall the program it belongs to. That step can then fail, because Windows looks for this file and it isn't there.
To try and fix it, download that program's installer from its maker and run it over your existing copy (don't uninstall first, uninstalling is itself a step that needs this file). Use the version you have installed if you can get it, as Windows may reject a different one. This usually restores the file, and your settings are normally untouched, but Microsoft doesn't guarantee it, its own last resort is reinstalling the program, or Windows itself.
data.comment: Shown in the Registered Files details pane when a selected product's installer file is gone from disk. Generic with no product name interpolated: the recovery advice is identical for every program, and a possessive on a name ending in s reads wrongly.

data.value:
Windows відмовив InstallerClean у доступі, тому роботу було зупинено. Нічого не було видалено.
InstallerClean уже працював від імені адміністратора, тож запускати його так ще раз не допоможе. Windows не повідомляє нічого більше про те, що саме відмовило в доступі, тож немає нічого конкретного, що варто спробувати.

data.name: Error.InstallerDbEmpty
data.value: Записи Windows Installer повернулися цілком порожніми: жодна встановлена програма й жодне оновлення не заявляє прав на кешований файл інсталятора. На робочому комп'ютері такого не буває (навіть у щойно встановленої Windows такі файли є), тож записи або пошкоджено, або їх не вдалося прочитати, і сканування, яке повірило б такій відповіді, помилково визнало б осиротілим кожен файл у {InstallerFolder}. Замість цього InstallerClean зупинився. Нічого не було видалено.

data.name: Error.MsiAccessDenied
data.value: Windows Installer не дозволив InstallerClean перелічити встановлене. InstallerClean уже працював від імені адміністратора, тож запуск від імені адміністратора ще раз нічого не змінить. Без цього списку немає безпечного способу визначити, які кешовані файли ще потрібні, тож InstallerClean зупинився. Нічого не було видалено.

data.name: Error.MsiPatchEnumerationNeverEnded

data.name: Error.ScanCorrelationFailed
data.value: InstallerClean couldn't square this scan with the Windows Installer records: nearly every file Windows still lists as needed is missing from {InstallerFolder}, while what is actually in the folder matches almost nothing in the records. No real machine looks like that, so it points to a problem reading the records, not to files you can safely remove. Nothing has been offered for cleanup and nothing has been removed.

Файл міг видаватися осиротілим лише тому, що запис, який його називає, виявився одним із нечитабельних, тож InstallerClean зупинився. Нічого не було видалено.
